## Invitations

The outreach activity recorded 1813 invitations. Of the people invited, 1295 attended. This represents an attendance rate of 71.4 per cent. The figures provide a clear summary of the invitation and attendance outcome for the reporting period. Attendance is reported against the total number invited, allowing the rate to be understood alongside the underlying counts.

The attendance total reflects those who came following the invitation. The rate of 71.4 per cent is based on 1295 attendees from the 1813 people invited.

## Contact

The contact record shows that 1563 invitations were sent with an SMS. A reminder message was also received by 1563 people. These figures are presented alongside the invitation and attendance results to describe the communication activity supporting the outreach.

The SMS and reminder totals are both recorded as 1563. This provides a consistent account of the contact undertaken in connection with the invitations.
